name: Invisible Beasts
source:
Enrico, a navy captain, investigates two mysterious and virulent deaths caused by some animal that can't be found during the carnival period of 1719 in Venice.

[From [url=https://synapsed.itch.io/invisible-beasts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1719年威尼斯狂欢节期间，海军舰长恩里科着手调查两起离奇而惨烈的死亡事件。凶手似乎是某种动物，却始终无迹可寻。

[摘自[url=https://synapsed.itch.io/invisible-beasts]Itch.io[/url]]
